claims.sentence: The MHRA says it has approved remibrutinib (Rhapsido) tablets for adults with chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) whose symptoms are not adequately controlled by antihistamines.
The approval came through the International Recognition Procedure (IRP), Route B.
The MHRA says the decision rests on two main clinical studies involving 925 adults who had not responded well enough to H1 antihistamines.
